tactical_thesis: Advance Steward to second 56, preserve the demonstrated opening interception assignments, and withdraw Vanilla after her second supported DP grant. Friston-3 inherits lower central blocking. Gallus inherits eastern lower roadblock clearance before contributing eastern artillery damage; Lava attacks the upper eastern artillery window. Keep Melantha through the first returning upper officer, then replace her with Noir Corne. Fresh Cardigan protects the lower western detention point. Midnight later replaces Fang under medical coverage, with Durin adding sustained central arts. Clear the two western roadblocks only after hostile clearance. Artillery death and every handoff are falsifiable requirements, not assumed outcomes or executable conditional guards.
